sources.version: AUA Diagnosis and Treatment of Early-Stage Testicular Cancer, published 2019 and amended 2023
sources.readScope: Official orchiectomy Guideline Statement 9 and accompanying counseling text: discuss prosthesis before orchiectomy; simultaneous or delayed placement; high satisfaction and low but nonzero morbidity.

sources.version: Torosa filling instructions; Testi10 IFU revision 08 dated 2023-02-22
sources.readScope: Torosa size/fill/port instructions and Testi10 models, sizes, indications, contraindications, warnings and precautions checked; not treated as comparative effectiveness evidence.
Complete indexed abstracts for Atwater, Besombes and Araújo; no abstract was counted as a full paper.

sources.version: Osemlak et al. 2018 pediatric retrospective cohort
sources.readScope: Accessible full text checked for methods, outcome definitions, complication counts and relevant age, timing and approach tables/discussion.

sources.version: AUA Evaluation and Treatment of Cryptorchidism, 2014; validity confirmed 2025
sources.readScope: Guideline Statements 13-16 and surrounding abdominal-testis treatment discussion read; autotransplantation is a sparsely used option, not one of the guideline's three usual repairs for a salvageable intra-abdominal testis.

sources.version: Bukowski 1995, Chao 2022 and Starmer 2018 indexed original/review abstracts
sources.readScope: Complete abstracts read: Bukowski 23 patients/27 testes, 96% author-defined success and operative times; Chao one 18-year-old case, technique and one-year outcome; Starmer eight replantation cases and 5/11 viable-sperm denominator across all preservation approaches.

sources.version: BAUS consensus document for male genital emergencies - testicular trauma, 2018
sources.readScope: Full five-page PDF accessed; genital-mutilation, iatrogenic amputation, referral, fertility preservation and specialist microvascular passages read. Consensus/level-4 evidence boundary retained.
Documented Hayon/Araújo/Osemlak and clinical-companion source work reused. Historical technical and broader device/outcome packages remain explicitly unresolved.

claimChecks.claim: Prosthesis should be placed in all orchiectomy patients and simultaneous placement is universally preferred
claimChecks.locator: AUA Statement 9 and cohort timing evidence
claimChecks.note: The option should be discussed; simultaneous, delayed and no implant are preference-sensitive choices with individual clinical constraints.

claimChecks.claim: Fixation prevents migration without a meaningful downside
claimChecks.locator: Testi10 precautions and Besombes abstract Results
claimChecks.note: Manufacturer migration precaution is distinguished from a retrospective association between fixation, more discomfort and no positional benefit.

claimChecks.claim: Implantation does not impair sexual function
claimChecks.note: No statistically significant survey difference is not proof of no effect or benefit.

claimChecks.claim: Saline and silicone cohort percentages provide a valid head-to-head material comparison
claimChecks.locator: Heterogeneous observational cohorts and unresolved device packages
claimChecks.note: Table now compares design considerations and explicitly rejects cross-cohort causal inference.

claimChecks.claim: Pediatric timing and suprascrotal access are universal standards
claimChecks.note: Findings are labeled single-center nonrandomized associations and timing remains individualized.

claimChecks.claim: Every retained adult, pediatric, gender-affirming, experimental and device-specific statement has full-source verification
claimChecks.locator: Outstanding full papers, labels and video
claimChecks.note: Obtain the complete source packages before clinical clearance.

claimChecks.claim: AUA lists autotransplantation alongside the three usual repairs for a salvageable intra-abdominal testis
claimChecks.note: The usual repairs are primary and one-/two-stage Fowler-Stephens; autotransplantation is separately described as sparingly used.

claimChecks.claim: Animal cooling percentages and individual case ischemia times define safe human cutoffs
claimChecks.locator: BAUS genital-mutilation guidance, Starmer abstract and unresolved animal/full-case packages
claimChecks.note: Animal figures are labeled experimental and case times feasibility observations; urgent specialist assessment remains required.

claimChecks.claim: Chao 2022 is a robotic series supporting standard sutures, bed rest and discharge rules
claimChecks.note: It is one 18-year-old case; its technique and postoperative course are explicitly case-specific.

claimChecks.claim: Starmer found viable sperm in about half of traumatic replantations
claimChecks.note: Five of eleven applies across replantation, TESE and cryopreservation combined, not the eight replantations alone.

claimChecks.claim: Historical anatomical success rates predict normal fertility, endocrine function or current-center results
claimChecks.locator: Bukowski abstract and unresolved heterogeneous series
claimChecks.note: Table is labeled author-defined historical outcomes with explicit limits on fertility, endocrine and generalizability inference.
